name: Winterfest at the Mansion at Tuckahoe
venue: The Mansion at Tuckahoe, Indian Riverside Park
address: 1707 NE Indian River Drive, Jensen Beach, FL
paras: Martin County Parks and Recreation hosts Winterfest on Friday, December 11, from 5:30 to 9 PM at The Mansion at Tuckahoe in Indian Riverside Park, 1707 NE Indian River Drive, Jensen Beach. The county describes it as an all-in-one festive celebration with live entertainment, games, vendors and plenty of holiday spirit.

The county's sponsor page lists a variety of talent, a visit from Santa, arts and crafts, face painting and food trucks, and reports a turnout of more than 1,000 people at the festival. Guests are invited to bring friends and family and wear their best festive attire.
The Children's Services Council of Martin County supports the event, which is held at the outdoor amphitheater at the Mansion at Tuckahoe.
tip: Wear festive attire, since the county invites it.

name: Community Movie Night: Home Alone at Wojcieszak Park
when_note: Friday, December 18, 5:30 to 8 PM, with the movie at 6 PM
paras: Martin County Parks and Recreation shows Home Alone on a 20-foot LED screen at Wojcieszak Park, 4733 SE Group Ave, Stuart, on Friday, December 18. The county lists the evening from 5:30 to 8 PM for all ages.
Food trucks open at 5:30 PM and the movie starts at 6 PM. Families bring blankets or lawn chairs and settle in for a relaxed outdoor movie night.
The county runs six community movie nights at different parks in Martin County, using the same 20-foot LED screen for family-friendly films.
tip: Bring a blanket or lawn chairs and arrive near 5:30 PM when the food trucks open.
